findings.note: MLB.com's Game 1 recap says Caminero avoided serious injury in a late-game collision with outfielder Jonny DeLuca and puts the focus back on him for Tuesday's Game 2, but it gives no practice or lineup confirmation for this game.

CBS's Game 1 live blog shows Caminero hit an RBI single early, then Cleveland relievers struck him out twice (Espino in the 5th, Gaddis on a changeup in the 7th), and he went down clutching his chest after the collision before staying in the game.

A Covers analyst picked Caminero Over 1.5 hits+runs+RBI for Game 1 against lefty Foster Griffin, pointing to his .390 wOBA against left-handers. That pick was for a different game and market, not Game 2 total bases.
